शुप् शुप्, (in grammar) a technical term
for the affix उ, the characteristic sign of the eighth
class of verbs.

सुप् सुप्, (in grammar) the technical ex-
pression for the termination of the locative case
plural; a Pratyāhāra used as a technical expression
for all the twenty-one case-terminations; a term for
any one of these case-endings.
—सुब्-अन्त, अम्, n.
a technical expression for an inflected noun as ending
with a case-termination.

शूपकार शूप-कार, अस्, m. (for सूप-कार,
q. v.), one who lives by cooking for Śūdras (= शूद्र-
पाकोपजीविन्).

सुप्त सुप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्वप्), slept;
sleeping, asleep; paralyzed, numbed, insensible;
(अम्), n. sleep, deep or sound sleep.
—सुप्त-घा-
तक, अस्, ई, अम्, ‘killing a sleeping person,’ mur-
derous.
—सुप्त-जन, अस्, m. a sleeping person;
‘having every person asleep,’ midnight.
—सुप्त-
जन-प्राय, अस्, आ, अम्, having almost every person
asleep.
—सुप्त-ज्ञान, अम्, n. ‘sleep-knowledge,’ a
dream, dreaming.
—सुप्त-त्वच्, क्, क्, क्, ‘having
the skin benumbed,’ paralytic.
—सुप्त-विज्ञान,
अम्, n. ‘sleep-knowledge,’ a dream, dreaming.
—सुप्तोत्थित (˚त-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, arisen from
sleep, just arisen after sleep.
सुप्त, सुप्ति. See s. v., p. 1128.

सुप्ति, इस्, f. sleep, sleepiness, drowsiness; numb-
ness, insensibility, paralysis; trust, confidence.

सुप्लन् सुप्लन्, m., N. of a person (having
the patronymic Sārñjaya).

. said
to be fr. rt. 3. सु, ‘to distil;’ cf. सूद), sauce, con-
diment; soup, broth; split pease; a cook; one who
lives by cooking for Śūdras (शूद्र-पाकोपजीविन्);
a vessel, pot, pan; an arrow; [cf. Old Germ. suf,
sufan, saufjan; Old Norse sup; Angl. Sax. su-
pan.]
—सूप-कार, अस्, m. ‘sauce-maker,’ a cook.
—सूप-धूपन or सूप-धूपक, अम्, n. ‘scent-
ing sauce,’ Asa Fetida.
—सूप-पर्णी, f. a sort of
bean (= मुद्ग-पर्णी).
—सूप-प्रति, ind. a little
sauce or soup, (Pāṇ.

.)
—सूप-श्रेष्ठ,
अस्, m. ‘best of sauces,’ a sort of bean.
—सूपाङ्ग
(˚प-अङ्˚), अम्, n. ‘sauce-ingredient,’ Asa Fetida.

सूपस्कर सूपस्कर, सूपस्थ. See p. 1126,
col. 2.
सुप्त्वा, ind. having slept, having gone to sleep.
